$comment: The jobs of the engineering's continuous integration, in one place (G6-7). The reusable workflow (.github/workflows/engineering-verify.yml) and the client caller template (ci/templates/caller.yml) must each carry exactly these jobs; check:ci compares them with this table. A mode is one way the composite action (.github/actions/engineering) runs the engineering; a client cannot ask for anything else, and the blocking job runs the whole verification.

jobs.name: external links (informational)
jobs.step: Verify the external destinations (record printed in the log)

jobs.name: lighthouse (informational)
jobs.step: Lighthouse (every page, three runs each; the table is printed in the log)

scheduled.$comment: The only jobs a scheduled caller may carry. There is no live-site mode: monitoring a live site needs its own authorisation and does not exist here.
